'''Threll''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During a mission in a dense jungle, Threll directed the eight [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under his command to repair a [[Cargo speeder/Legends|cargo speeder]]. Sometime after, Threll's command encountered a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]], and they proceeded to ambush the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]].<ref name="TRG" />
